briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ -0.0%, S&P 500 -0.1%), showing no clear risk-on signal despite three open portfolio slots and $689 in cash. Per past lessons, forcing a buy on a neutral day just to deploy capital has proven unwise — we're holding cash and letting existing positions (QQQ, EAT, OLED, WT, ROAD, INOD, MU) ride until either a genuine multi-signal risk-on setup emerges or automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules trigger.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' or neutral market day is when investors aren't strongly favoring growth stocks over safety, often shown by flat index moves. The lesson here is patience: it's usually better to hold cash and wait for a clear signal (like a strong up day with heavy volume) than to buy just because you have money sitting idle.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好回落」或中性市況,是指投資者未有明顯傾向追捧增長型股票,通常反映在指數升跌幅度輕微。今日的教訓在於耐性:與其因為手頭有閒置現金而勉強入市,不如耐心等待明確訊號(例如成交量放大的強勢上升日)出現後才行動。

market_education.summary_en: Today's session was essentially directionless, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 posting negligible moves of less than 0.1%. Without a strong catalyst or broad-based volume surge behind the day's top momentum names, there isn't enough conviction to call this a risk-on environment. Flat, low-conviction days like this are typically consolidation phases rather than trend reversals.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市方向不明,納指及標普500指數升跌幅度均不足0.1%,可謂波瀾不驚。由於缺乏強力催化劑,今日表現最強勢股份亦未見明顯成交量放大支持,故未足以判斷為「風險偏好」上升的市況。這類窄幅波動、缺乏方向的交易日,一般屬於整固階段,而非趨勢逆轉的訊號。
